description_en: Manually run remediation for a specified account group rule
description_zh: 手动执行指定的账号组规则修正
kebab_example: aliyun config start-aggregate-remediation --config-rule-id cr-6b7c626622af00b40000 --aggregator-id ca-6b4a626622af00120000 --resource-id vpc-xxx --resource-type ACS::VPC::VPC --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-account-id 1002718975420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartAggregateRemediation

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the rule.

To get the rule ID, see [ListAggregateConfigRules](~~264148~~).
parameters.description_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见[ListAggregateConfigRules](~~264148~~)。

parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resources to be remediated belong. If this parameter is left empty, non-compliant resources of all accounts in the account group are remediated.

> You must specify the ID of the current management account or a member account in the account group of the management account.
parameters.description_zh:
要执行修正的资源归属的阿里云账号ID，该参数为空时表示修正账号组内所有账号的不合规资源。

> 该账号只能是当前企业管理账号或当前企业管理账号中的成员账号。
